PcosSkinHair.6: PCOS irashobora gutuma uruhu, ubuhanga bwo ku mubiri canke imisatsi yo ku mutwe bihinduka mu buryo bugaragara. Kumenya aho biva biraborohereza kubimenya no kumenya ibisubizo vyokwitwararikwa.
PcosSkinHair.7: Ibi bimenyetso birakunze, ariko ubwabyo ntibisabwa kandi ntibihagije ngo hemezwe PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.10: Utubyimba two ku ruhu duterwa na hormone
PcosSkinHair.19: PCOS irashobora kuzana ukwiyongera kw'ugukora canke ingufu za androgène, hormone nazo ziba mu bagore mu buryo busanzwe. Iyo ingaruka zazo ziyongereye, zirashobora kugira ingaruka ku nsoro zitanga amavuta y'uruhu, ku mizi y'ubwoya n'imisatsi, no ku buryo ubwoya bukura.
PcosSkinHair.20: Iyi ngaruka ya hormone ni yo ikunze gusobanura igituma haboneka utubyimba tudahera ku ruhu, ubwoya bwinshi, canke, ku bagore bamwebamwe, imisatsi igabanuka.
PcosSkinHair.22: Ibimenyetso bigaragara ntibigaragaza ko PCOS ikaze. Umugore umwe ashobora kugira ibimenyetso bigaragara vyinshi, uwundi akagira bike canke atabigira na gato.
PcosSkinHair.23: Utubyimba two ku ruhu duhujwe n'impinduka za hormone dushobora kuboneka canke kuguma no hanyuma y'ubwangavu. Dukunze gufata mu gatuza, ku rurasukiro rw'umusaya, ku masaya yo hasi, canke rimwe na rimwe ku ijosi.
PcosSkinHair.24: Ku bantu bamwebamwe, utwo tubyimba ni tw'imbere cane, tubabaza kandi turagaruka. Dushobora kandi gusiga ibimenyetso bifise ibara canke inkovu iyo bikorakorwa canke iyo bibyimbye cane.
PcosSkinHair.26: Utubyimba tudahera ku ruhu, cane cane mu maso hasi
PcosSkinHair.27: Uruhu rufise amavuta arenze ayo rwari rufise
PcosSkinHair.28: Utubyimba dusubira kuvuka rimwe na rimwe hakurikiye impinduka za hormone
PcosSkinHair.29: Ibimenyetso canke inkovu zisigaye hanyuma y'utubyimba
PcosSkinHair.30: Hirsutisme ni ukwiyongera k'ubwoya bukomeye mu bice bidakunze kugira ubwoya ku bagore. Muri PCOS, birashobora guhuzwa n'ingaruka za androgène ku mizi y'ubwoya.
PcosSkinHair.31: Ibice bikunze gufatwa ni urwasaya, hejuru y'iminwa, igituza, inda canke umugongo. Ingene ubwoya bukura biratandukanye cane hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi.
PcosSkinHair.34: Ubwoya bukomeye ku rwasaya canke hejuru y'iminwa
PcosSkinHair.35: Ubwoya bushobora kuboneka ku gituza, ku nda canke ku mugongo
PcosSkinHair.36: Imisatsi igabanuka buhoro buhoro hejuru y'umutwe
PcosSkinHair.38: Ukuntu ubwoya bukura kandi biterwa n'imvukire n'ibiranga umuntu. Kubona ubwoya bwinshi ntibisobanura ko PCOS ihari.
PcosSkinHair.39: Abagore bamwebamwe bafise PCOS na bo babona ko imisatsi yabo igabanutse. Ukugabanuka kurashobora kugaragara cane hejuru y'umutwe canke ku rutonde rw'imisatsi rwo hagati.
PcosSkinHair.40: Ibi birashobora kuza buhoro buhoro. Ni ngirakamaro gutandukanya ukwugurika kw'imisatsi guhuzwa na hormone n'izindi mvo zishoboka, nko kubura ibitunga umubiri, ikibazo c'igitigiri c'ijosi (thyroïde), imiti imwimwe, canke igihe c'umunaniro mwinshi.
PcosSkinHair.42: Imisatsi yugurika cane, vuba canke mu buryo budasanzwe bikwiye gusuzumwa na muganga kugira ngo hamenyekane igitera.
PcosSkinHair.43: Uburyo bworoshe kandi buhoraho bukunze kuba bwiza kuruta gushiramwo ibicuruzwa vyinshi. Intumbero ni ugusukura, gutose no kurinda uruhu mu gihe hirindwa ikintu cose gishobora gukomeza kurubabaza.
PcosSkinHair.44: Uburyo bworoshe kandi buhoraho bwo kwita ku ruhu
PcosSkinHair.48: Iyo imisatsi iba mito, bishobora gufasha kugabanya ivyo ibabazwa kenshi: ubushuhe bukabije, ukuyisokoza cane, canke imiti y'imiti ikoreshwa kenshi.
PcosSkinHair.49: Kubonana n'umuganga w'uruhu birashobora kugira akamaro iyo imisatsi ikomeza kugabanuka, kugira ngo hamenyekane igitera hamwe n'imiti ihari.
PcosSkinHair.51: Hitamwo ibicuruzwa byoroshe kandi wirinde gushira hamwe imiti myinshi ibabaza
PcosSkinHair.52: Sukura uruhu utarwangije, mu gitondo na nimugoroba nibiba ngombwa
PcosSkinHair.53: Rinda uruhu izuba iyo ruri hanze
PcosSkinHair.54: Wirinde gukorakora utubyimba kugira ngo ugabanye ibimenyetso n'inkovu
PcosSkinHair.55: Saba inama umuhanga iyo ibimenyetso bikomeje canke bikaba bibi
PcosSkinHair.56: Uburyo bwo kubigenza buterwa n'ibimenyetso, ububasha bwabyo, ingaruka bifise ku buzima bwa buri musi, n'ivyo umugore ashaka. Birashobora gufasha gukora mu buryo bwinshi aho gushaka igisubizo kimwe gusa.
PcosSkinHair.58: Uburyo bubereye n'inama z'umuganga w'uruhu nibiba ngombwa.
PcosSkinHair.60: Ibisubizo vy'ubwiza canke vy'ubuvuzi bitewe n'uko ibintu bimeze.
PcosSkinHair.62: Menya igitera imbere yo guhitamwo umuti.
PcosSkinHair.64: Raba ingaruka ibimenyetso bigira ku mutima.
PcosSkinHair.65: Ni vyiza kuvugana n'umuhanga mu buvuzi iyo utubyimba two ku ruhu dukomeje canke dubabaza, iyo ubwoya bwiyongera vuba, iyo imisatsi igabanutse cane, canke iyo izi mpinduka zijana n'imihango idahoraho cane.
PcosSkinHair.66: Umuganga w'uruhu arashobora kuvura ibimenyetso vyo ku ruhu no ku misatsi. Umuganga w'abagore canke undi muhanga w'ubuvuzi arashobora kandi gusuzuma ibijanye na hormone n'ibindi bimenyetso bishoboka vya PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.68: Ubwoya bukura vuba kandi cane, imisatsi yugurika gitumo, canke impinduka za hormone zidasanzwe bisaba inama z'umuganga.
PcosSkinHair.69: Kugira utubyimba two ku ruhu ntibisobanura ko ufise PCOS
PcosSkinHair.70: Ubwoya bugaragara ntibuhuzwa na hormone gusa
PcosSkinHair.71: PCOS irashobora gufata abagore bafise umubiri wose
PcosSkinHair.72: Ibimenyetso birashobora guhinduka uko igihe gihita kandi ntibingana ku bagore bose
PcosSkinHair.73: Ibimenyetso bigaragara bya PCOS birashobora gutuma ubabara, ariko ntibigaragaza ubugore bwawe, agaciro kawe, canke isuku yawe.
PcosSkinHair.75: PCOS irashobora gufata uruhu, ubwoya bwo ku mubiri n'imisatsi yo ku mutwe.
PcosSkinHair.76: Ibimenyetso biratandukanye cane hagati y'umugore n'uwundi.
PcosSkinHair.77: Ikimenyetso kimwe ntigihagije kugira ngo hemezwe PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.79: Ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi bushobora kugufasha guhitamwo inzira ikubereye.
PcosSkinHair.81: Utubyimba two ku ruhu, ubwoya bwinshi canke imisatsi yugurika birashobora kuba ibimenyetso vya PCOS, ariko ntibiba ngombwa. Uburyo bwihariye bwakubereye burashobora kugufasha kubigenza neza no kwumva umerewe neza buri musi.
PcosSkinHair.82: Iyi nkuru ni iy'ukumenyesha gusa kandi ntisubira mu cimbo c'ukubonana na muganga, isuzuma canke umuti wagenewe wowe.
PcosSkinHair.83: Uruhu, imisatsi n'ibimenyetso bigaragara vya PCOS — AWA

PerineumStrengthening.1:
Gutera imbaraga imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo
hanyuma y'ukubyara
PerineumStrengthening.6: Hanyuma yo gutwita no kubyara, imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo isaba igihe co gukira. Imyitozo yoroshe, ihoraho kandi ijanye n'ingene ugenda ukira irashobora kugufasha kugarura imbaraga, ububasha n'icizere, utihuta.
PerineumStrengthening.8: Gusobanukirwa uruhara rw'imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo (perineum)
PerineumStrengthening.9: Igituma kubyara bigira ingaruka kuri yo
PerineumStrengthening.10: Igihe co gutangura imyitozo y'iyo mikaya
PerineumStrengthening.12: Gushiraho gahunda ijanye n'ingene ugenda ukira
PerineumStrengthening.18: Gutera imbaraga imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo hanyuma y'ukubyara — AWA
PerineumStrengthening.19: Gusobanukirwa uruhara rw'imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo (perineum)
PerineumStrengthening.20: Perineum, yitwa kandi imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo, ni itsinda ry'imikaya iri munsi y'igikanka c'inda. Igira uruhara mu kugenzura inkari n'amabyi kandi ifasha gushigikira ingingo zo mu nda y'epfo.
PerineumStrengthening.21: Mu gihe co gutwita, iyi mikaya itwara uburemere burenze amezi menshi. Kandi irabazwa cane mu gihe co kubyara.
PerineumStrengthening.23: Imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo igira uruhara mu bikorwa vyinshi vya buri musi: gufata inkari n'amabyi, kugenzura umwuka usohoka, gushigikira ingingo zo mu nda y'epfo, no kugira uruhara mu bikorwa bimwebimwe vy'imibonano.
PerineumStrengthening.24: Akamaro ko kugira imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo ikomeye
PerineumStrengthening.25: Gutera imbaraga buhoro buhoro kandi neza birashobora gufasha kunoza ukugenzura n'ugushigikira kw'iyi mikaya.
PerineumStrengthening.28: Imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo igira uruhara mu kugenzura inkari. Kuyiha imbaraga buhoro buhoro bishobora gufasha kugabanya inkari zimwezimwe zisohoka ku gahato.
PerineumStrengthening.31: Iyi mikaya kandi ifasha kugenzura umwuka n'amabyi kandi igashigikira ingingo zo mu nda y'epfo.
PerineumStrengthening.33: Gushigikira ingingo zo mu nda y'epfo
PerineumStrengthening.34: Imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo ni nk'ishingiro ry'imikaya rifasha gushigikira uruhago, nyababyeyi n'amara.
PerineumStrengthening.37: Imyitozo ibereye irashobora kandi kugufasha kumenya no kugenzura neza aka gace.
PerineumStrengthening.38: Igituma gutwita no kubyara bigira ingaruka kuri yo
PerineumStrengthening.39: Gutwita bishira buhoro buhoro igitutu kinini ku mikaya yo mu nda y'epfo. Kubyara mu buryo busanzwe birashobora gukurura cane iyi mikaya n'ibindi bice vyo muri aka gace.
PerineumStrengthening.40: Kubyara bakubaga na vyo ntibirinda iyi mikaya rwose: gutwita ubwabyo biguma ari igihe gikomeye kuri yo.
PerineumStrengthening.41: Hanyuma y'ukubyara, nta cantangaza gukira gufata igihe. Abagore bamwebamwe ntibabona ibimenyetso biruta, abandi bashobora kubona inkari zisohoka, ukumva uburemere, canke imikaya itagishoboye kugenzurwa.
PerineumStrengthening.43: Uburyo wabyayemwo, gutabuka canke gukatwa (episiotomie), ububabare, n'uko umerewe muri rusangi hanyuma y'ukubyara, vyose bishobora kugira ingaruka ku gukira.
PerineumStrengthening.44: Igihe co gutangura imyitozo y'iyi mikaya?
PerineumStrengthening.45: Hanyuma y'ukubyara nta kibazo, imyitozo yoroshe yo gukanda imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo isanzwe isubukurwa buhoro buhoro. Biracari ngombwa guhuza imyitozo n'uko umeze no gusaba inama niba wagize ingorane, ububabare bukomeye, canke igikorwa c'ubuvuzi cihariye.
PerineumStrengthening.46: Niba ufise umuyoboro w'inkari (sonde), inama zimwezimwe zerekana ko wogereza imyitozo y'iyi mikaya kugeza igihe uvanyweho kandi ukongera kunyara bisanzwe.
PerineumStrengthening.48: Ububabare bukomeye, ibimenyetso bikaze, ibarwe ritakira neza, canke ikindi kibazo cose bisaba inama z'umubyaza, muganga canke umuhanga mu gufasha gukira.
PerineumStrengthening.50: Kugira ngo umenye ukuntu bikorwa, tekereza ko ugerageza gufata umwuka n'icifuzo co kunyara icarimwe. Ico ushaka ni ukwumva imikaya ikandaguye kandi izamutse imbere.
PerineumStrengthening.51: Intumbero si ugukanda umubiri wose. Ibibuno, ibibero n'inda bigomba kuguma biruhutse uko bishoboka, mu gihe uhumeka bisanzwe.
PerineumStrengthening.61: Nyuma ya buri gukanda, reka imikaya iruhuke rwose. Imyitozo myiza ntisobanura gukomeza gukanda perineum umusi wose.
PerineumStrengthening.62: Gushiraho gahunda ijanye n'ingene ugenda ukira
PerineumStrengthening.63: Mu ntango, ico gihambaye cane ni ukwiga kumenya iyi mikaya no gukora igikorwa neza. Gukora buri musi biruta ububasha bwinshi.
PerineumStrengthening.65: Kanda imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo buhoro, hanyuma ugumane gukanda amasegonda make utafashe umwuka. Hanyuma uyirekure rwose imbere yo gutangura bundi bushasha.
PerineumStrengthening.67: Igihe umaze kumenya igikorwa, ushobora kongeraho gukanda gutoya kandi kwihuta. Bifasha imikaya kwiga gukanda vuba iyo igitutu c'inda cyiyongereye, nk'imbere gato yo gukorora canke gucinya.
PerineumStrengthening.69: Huza imyitozo n'ingeso ya buri musi
PerineumStrengthening.80: Gukora buri musi imbere ya vyose
PerineumStrengthening.81: Guhuza imyitozo n'ingeso usanzwe ufise bishobora koroshya gukomeza: hanyuma yo konsa, hanyuma yo koza amenyo, canke ikindi gihe kikubereye.
PerineumStrengthening.83: Imyitozo y'iyi mikaya irashobora kugaragara nk'ihendutse, ariko biroroshe gukoresha izindi mikaya canke gukanda cane.
PerineumStrengthening.84: Gukanda ibibuno canke ibibero aho gukanda imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo
PerineumStrengthening.86: Guguma ukanze imikaya udasiga ngo iruhuke
PerineumStrengthening.87: Gukora imyitozo iminsi mike hanyuma ukayireka
PerineumStrengthening.88: Guhagarika inkari ku bushake kugira ngo ugerageze gukanda
PerineumStrengthening.90: Ntibisabwa gukora imyitozo uhagarika inkari ku bushake. Ubu buryo ntibutoza neza perineum kandi bushobora kuvuruga imikorere isanzwe y'uruhago.
PerineumStrengthening.91: Ni ibihe bimenyetso bikwiye kugutuma ubonana na muganga?
PerineumStrengthening.92: Inkari zitoya zisohoka canke ukumva ibidasanzwe birashobora rimwe na rimwe kuboneka hanyuma y'ukubyara. Ariko ntibikwiye kwirengagizwa iyo bikomeje, biba bibi, canke bibangamira ubuzima bwawe bwa buri musi.
PerineumStrengthening.93: Inkari zisohoka iyo ukorora, ucinya, useka canke ukoresha imbaraga
PerineumStrengthening.94: Ukumva uburemere canke igitutu mu nda y'epfo
PerineumStrengthening.95: Ukumva nk'ikintu gikomeye canke ikintu kimanuka mu gitsina
PerineumStrengthening.96: Ingorane zo gufata umwuka canke amabyi
PerineumStrengthening.98: Ububabare mu gihe canke hanyuma y'imibonano
PerineumStrengthening.99: Ingorane zo kumenya canke gukanda neza imikaya ya perineum
PerineumStrengthening.101: Umubyaza, muganga canke umuhanga mu gufasha gukira (physiothérapeute) w'imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo arashobora gusuzuma imikorere y'imikaya akagusaba imyitozo ibereye.
PerineumStrengthening.102: Ni gute hanyuma yo gutabuka, gukatwa (episiotomie) canke kubyara bakubaga?
PerineumStrengthening.103: Gutabuka canke gukatwa bisaba kwitwararika mu gihe c'ugukira. Gusubira mu bikorwa bikwiye kwitwararika ububabare, uko ibarwe rimeze, n'amabwiriza wahawe hanyuma y'ukubyara.
PerineumStrengthening.104: Hanyuma yo kubyara bakubaga, ugukira kuraba kandi kuri ruhago rw'inda n'ibarwe. N'iyo kubyara bitabaye mu buryo busanzwe, gutwita ubwabyo vyagize ingaruka ku mikaya yo mu nda y'epfo.
PerineumStrengthening.105: Kwitabwaho mu buryo bwihariye bishobora gufasha
PerineumStrengthening.106: Mu gihe c'ugutabuka gukomeye, ububabare, ibimenyetso vy'inkari canke vy'amara, canke ingorane zikomeje, isuzuma ry'umuhanga mu buvuzi rirashobora gufasha cane.
PerineumStrengthening.108: Gusubira mu bikorwa hanyuma y'ukubyara bikwiye kuba buhoro buhoro. Kugenda n'ibikorwa byoroshe bishobora gusubukurwa bitewe n'ukuntu wumva umerewe, mu gihe ibikorwa bikomeye bisaba kwitonda cane.
PerineumStrengthening.109: Imbere yo gusubira mu kwiruka, gusimbuka, canke imyitozo ikaze cane, ni vyiza gusuzuma ugukira kw'imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo no kwitwararika ibimenyetso vyose.
PerineumStrengthening.111: Inkari zisohoka, ukumva uburemere, canke ububabare mu gihe canke hanyuma y'imyitozo ni ibimenyetso vyerekana ko ukwiye kugabanya kandi ugasaba inama imbere yo kongera imbaraga.
PerineumStrengthening.113: Imyitozo y'imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo hamwe n'umubyaza canke physiothérapeute irashobora kugira akamaro niba utazi neza ko ukanda neza, niba ibimenyetso bikomeje, canke niba ushaka gusubira mu bikorwa vy'umubiri ufise icizere.
PerineumStrengthening.115: Ese ibimenyetso vyanje bijanye n'imikaya yo mu nda y'epfo idakomeye?
PerineumStrengthening.117: Ni kangahe nkwiye gukora imyitozo buri musi?
PerineumStrengthening.118: Ese nshobora gusubira mu kwiruka, mu mikino, canke mu myitozo ikaze?
PerineumStrengthening.119: Ese nkeneye imyitozo y'ugukira hamwe n'umubyaza canke physiothérapeute?
PerineumStrengthening.120: Ese ibarwe ryanje, ugutabuka canke ukubyara bakubaga bisaba kwitwararika kwihariye?
PerineumStrengthening.122: Kubonana n'umuhanga ntibisobanura ko hari ikitagenda. Isuzuma rirashobora gusa gufasha kugenzura uburyo ukora, gusuzuma ugukira kwawe no kwiga gutera imbere neza.
PerineumStrengthening.124: Hanyuma yo kubyara, nta cantangaza kudasubira vuba kubona ukumva canke imbaraga z'imikaya wari ufise imbere yo gutwita.
PerineumStrengthening.125: Intumbero si ugukanda kenshi gashoboka. Ni ugusubirana buhoro buhoro uburyo bwiza hagati yo gukanda no kuruhuka, hanyuma ugashobora gukoresha iyi mikaya mu buryo busanzwe mu bikorwa vya buri musi.
PerineumStrengthening.127: Kurushiriza kumenya igikorwa, amasegonda make y'ugukanda arenga, canke ukugabanuka kw'inkari zisohoka biri mu bimenyetso bitanga akanyabugabo.
PerineumStrengthening.130: Gutwita no kubyara bigira ingaruka nini ku mikaya yo mu nda y'epfo.
PerineumStrengthening.131: Gukira buhoro buhoro ni ibisanzwe hanyuma y'ukubyara.
PerineumStrengthening.132: Imyitozo ikwiye kwitwararika ubuhanga bw'igikorwa kuruta imbaraga.
PerineumStrengthening.133: Guhumeka no kuruhuka ni ngirakamaro nko gukanda.
PerineumStrengthening.134: Inkari zisohoka, ukumva uburemere, canke ububabare buhoraho bikwiye inama z'umuhanga.
PerineumStrengthening.135: Imyitozo y'ugukira hamwe n'umubyaza canke physiothérapeute irashobora kugufasha kugarura ukugenzura kwiza.
PerineumStrengthening.136: Gusubira mu mikino bikwiye kuba buhoro buhoro, cane cane ku bikorwa bikaze.
PerineumStrengthening.138: Hanyuma y'ukubyara, umubiri wawe wanyuze mu mpinduka nyinshi. Perineum ikwiye kwitabwaho nk'ibindi bice vy'umubiri wawe: buhoro buhoro, buri musi, kandi nta gitutu.
PerineumStrengthening.139: Iyi nkuru ni iy'ukumenyesha gusa kandi ntisubira mu cimbo c'inama z'ubuvuzi zagenewe wowe. Niba ufise ububabare, ibimenyetso bikomeje, canke ufise ikibazo cose ku gukira kwawe, saba inama umuhanga mu buvuzi.

PeriodPain.6: Ubushuhe, imyitozo yoroshe, ifunguro: ingeso zifasha koko.
PeriodPain.12: Ububabare buva ku gukanda kwa nyababyeyi gufasha gusohora ibiyiriho. Buterwa na prostaglandines. Umubiri wose uvyakira mu buryo butandukanye.
PeriodPain.14: Ububabare bushobora gutandukana hagati y'uruzinduko n'urundi kandi ntibuhora bumeze kimwe.
PeriodPain.16: Icupa ry'amazi ashushe ku nda yo hasi rirashobora gutuma imikaya iruhuka.
PeriodPain.18: Yoga, kurambura umubiri no kugenda buhoro bigabanya umuhangayiko w'imikaya.
PeriodPain.22: Kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha kugabanya inda ibyimbye.
PeriodPain.24: Gukanda mu buryo bw'uruziga ku nda yo hasi bifasha kuruhuka.
PeriodPain.25: Niba ububabare bukubuza kubaho bisanzwe buri kwezi nubwo ukoresha ibi bisubizo, ni ngirakamaro kuvugana n'umuhanga mu buvuzi.
PeriodPain.27: Ububabare bukomeye cane, kuva amaraso menshi, umunaniro ukabije, canke ibimenyetso bidasanzwe.
PeriodPain.28: Shushisha umubiri wawe buhoro iyo ubyutse
PeriodPain.30: Fata igihe cyo guhumeka no kuruhuka
PeriodPain.31: Kurikirana uruzinduko rwawe kugira ngo umenye neza ububabare bwawe

Pms.4: PMS ifata gushika ku bagore 8 kuri 10. Umunaniro, kurakara, inda ibyimbye… Kumenya ivyo biva no gushira mu ngiro ingeso nziza birashobora gutuma iki gihe c'ukwezi kigenda neza cane.
Pms.11: Ibimenyetso bibanziriza imihango bihuza ibimenyetso vy'umubiri n'vyo mu mutima bikunze kuboneka iminsi 5 gushika 10 imbere y'imihango yawe bigashira mu ntango y'uruzinduko rw'imihango.
Pms.13: Ibimenyetso biboneka imbere y'imihango yawe kandi bikunze gutuma iyo itangiye.
Pms.15: Ububasha n'ubwoko bw'ibimenyetso birashobora gutandukana cane hagati y'umugore n'uwundi, no hagati y'uruzinduko n'urundi.
Pms.17: Kurakara, guhagarika umutima, agahinda, amarangamutima ahinduka
Pms.19: Inda ibyimbye, ububabare, umunaniro, kuribwa umutwe
Pms.21: Kwifuza isukari, impinduka mu kurya, umunaniro
Pms.23: Ingorane zo gusinzira canke ibitotsi bitaruhura
Pms.24: Impinduka za hormone, cane cane iza progestérone na œstrogène, zigira ingaruka ku bintu vyo mu bwonko bitwara amakuru (sérotonine, dopamine), bishobora gusobanura ibimenyetso vy'amarangamutima n'vy'umubiri vya PMS.
Pms.26: Impinduka za hormone zirashobora kugira ingaruka ku marangamutima, ku mbaraga, ku bitotsi no ku bimenyetso bimwebimwe vy'umubiri.
Pms.28: Kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha kugabanya inda ibyimbye.
Pms.30: Hitamwo ibiryo bifise magnésium, omega-3 n'ivitamini B nyinshi.
Pms.32: Imyitozo y'umubiri irekura endorphines kandi igabanya umunaniro wo mu mutima.
Pms.34: Imyitozo yo guhumeka, gutekereza utuje, kwandika ivyo wiyumvira… Shakashaka ico kigufasha.
Pms.36: Ibitotsi vyiza bishigikira uburinganire bwa hormone.
Pms.38: Niba ibimenyetso bikomeye cane kandi bigira ingaruka ku buzima bwawe bwa buri musi, bishobora kuba ari PMDD (premenstrual dysphoric disorder). Ntutinye kubonana n'umuhanga mu buvuzi.
Pms.39: Ibimenyetso bibanziriza imihango (PMS): bimenye neza — AWA

PostpartumPeriodReturn.1:
Isubira ry'imihango hanyuma y'ukubyara,
ivyo witeze
PostpartumPeriodReturn.4: Hanyuma y'ukubyara, isubira ry'imihango yawe rirashobora gufata igihe. Igihe riba kiratandukana bitewe, mu bindi, no konsa, kandi buri muntu ashobora kubona iki gihe mu buryo butandukanye.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.5: Isubira ry'imihango hanyuma y'ukubyara, ivyo witeze — AWA
PostpartumPeriodReturn.6: 1. Isubira ry'imihango hanyuma y'ukubyara ni iki?
PostpartumPeriodReturn.7: “Isubira ry'imihango” risobanura imihango yawe isubiye hanyuma y'ukubyara. Uruzinduko rw'imihango ntiruhita rusubira mu buryo rusanzwe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.11: Igihe giterwa cane no konsa. Utonse, imihango yawe isanzwe isubira hafi y'ibyumweru 6 gushika 8. Iyo wonsa gusa, irashobora gutinda amezi menshi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.17: Uruzinduko rusubira buhoro buhoro hanyuma y'ukubyara. Konsa bishobora kugira ingaruka ku gihe imihango yawe yongera kuboneka.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.21: Uruzinduko rw'imihango ruhagarara igihe gito hanyuma y'ukubyara.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.23: Umubiri urakira buhoro buhoro kandi urugero rwa hormone rurahinduka.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.25: Konsa bishobora gutinda isubira ry'imihango yawe, ariko ingaruka zabyo ziratandukana hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.27: Imihango yawe ya mbere ishobora gusubira hanyuma y'ibyumweru bike canke amezi menshi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.29: Inzinduko zishobora kutaba zihoraho imbere yo gusubira buhoro buhoro mu buryo busanzwe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.30: Nta gihe kimwe kigenewe bose. Igihe imihango yawe isubiriye gishobora gutandukana hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi, cane cane bitewe no konsa.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.32: Imihango yawe iyo isubiye, inzinduko za mbere zirashobora gutandukana n'izari imbere yo gutwita. Cane cane, zishobora kutaba zihoraho mu ntango.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.34: Uruzinduko rushobora gufata igihe imbere yo gusubira mu buryo busanzwe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.36: Amaraso ashobora gutandukana n'ayo wabonye imbere yo gutwita.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.38: Gukurikirana byoroshe bigufasha kwitegereza neza ingene uruzinduko rwawe ruhinduka uko igihe gihita.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.40: Andika umusi wa mbere w'imihango yawe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.42: Itegereze buhoro buhoro igihe kiri hagati y'inzinduko.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.44: Itegereze gusa impinduka zose ugereranije n'ivyo usanzwe ubona.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.46: Niba hari ikintu kigaragara nk'ikidasanzwe, gikomeje, canke kigutera impungenge, saba inama umuhanga mu buvuzi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.49: Umuriro canke ukumva umerewe nabi cane
PostpartumPeriodReturn.52: Isubira ry'imihango hanyuma y'ukubyara risobanura imihango yawe isubiye hanyuma y'ukubyara.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.53: Konsa bishobora gutinda isubira ry'imihango yawe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.54: Inzinduko za mbere zishobora kutaba zihoraho.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.55: Kwandika amatariki bishobora kugufasha gukurikirana ingene uruzinduko rwawe ruhinduka.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.56: Ibikubiyemo vy'ukumenyesha. Ibihe bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'uko ibintu bimeze kandi ntibisubira mu cimbo c'inama z'ubuvuzi.
